properties.rule: No homes, schools, childcare or playgrounds: 65 dB(A) or more by day. Noise-robust uses (work, parking, mobility) or a building or landform that shields what lies behind.
Homes only behind a shielding edge (55-65 dB(A) by day): closed side to the road, bedrooms and outdoor space on the quiet side. Offices, shops and services fit.
Keep the air corridor open: no buildings or high walls across it. Green, sport, water and paths fit.
Run streets, green strips and building rows along the air flow (towards about 186°), with gaps between buildings.
Shaded today, under half the possible sun hours: not for playgrounds, gardens or terraces.
Quiet and open to the air (under 55 dB(A) by day): best for homes, schools, childcare and play.

properties.name: 150 kV high-voltage line strip

properties.source: compensation areas (AF) along the B16, brief Fig. 28 (p.37) read by eye via structure-plan; brief p.28 keeps compensation areas; no analysis/ yet

properties.name: Biotope by the railway
properties.source: biotope structures brief Fig. 21 (p.32) and Fig. 27 (p.37) by eye via structure-plan; OSM forest

properties.source: existing buildings (site/buildings.geojson, OSM) inside site.geojson, merged with a 30 m buffer; third-party properties to keep, brief p. 30 and Fig. 26 (p. 36, by eye)

properties.name: Railside slope
properties.source: field between the sewer line and the railway, falling towards the rail; the brief wants a denser mixed edge along Pilsenallee and the railway that shields the homes behind (p. 28); phase 1, detail area 1 (p. 33)

properties.source: farmland between Chamer Straße and the B16 slope (site/plots.geojson)
